sanskrit: purojitī vo andhasaḥ sutāya mādayitnave | apa śvānaṁ śnathiṣṭana sakhāyo dīrghajihvyam ||
english: O friends, be foremost victors for the expressed soma-juice, for him who gives intoxicating joy. Smite away the long-tongued dog.

sanskrit: yo dhārayā pāvakayā pariprasyandate sutaḥ | indur aśvo na kṛtvyaḥ ||
english: He who, when pressed, flows all around with a purifying stream — the drop, like a willing horse.

sanskrit: taṁ duroṣam abhī naraḥ somaṁ viśvācyā dhiyā | yajñaṁ hinvanty adribhiḥ ||
english: Him, the inviolable soma, the men propel with all-encompassing thought and with the pressing-stones, urging on the sacrifice.

sanskrit: sutāso madhumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ | pavitravanto akṣaran devān gacchantu vo madāḥ ||
english: These pressed soma-juices, most honey-sweet, gladdening, for Indra — purified they have flowed; let your exhilarations go to the gods.

sanskrit: indur indrāya pavata iti devāso abruvan | vācas patir makhasyate viśvasyeśāna ojasā ||
english: "The drop flows purified for Indra" — thus the gods have spoken. Lord of speech, he is exuberant, ruling the all with might.

sanskrit: sahasradhāraḥ pavate samudro vācamīṅkhayaḥ | somaḥ patī rayīṇāṁ sakhendrasya dive-dive ||
english: With a thousand streams he flows purified, the ocean, stirring speech — soma, lord of riches, the ally of Indra day by day.

sanskrit: ayam pūṣā rayir bhagaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati | patir viśvasya bhūmano vy akhyad rodasī ubhe ||
english: This soma — Pūṣan, wealth, good fortune — flows while self-purifying; lord of all existence, he has gazed out over both worlds.

sanskrit: sam u priyā anūṣata gāvo madāya ghṛṣvayaḥ | somāsaḥ kṛṇvate pathaḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ ||
english: Together the dear ones have sounded in harmony — the vigorous kine; the somadrops, the flowing ones, make the paths for the pavamāna drops.

sanskrit: ya ojiṣṭhas tam ā bhara pavamāna śravāyyam | yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīr abhi rayiṁ yena vanāmahai ||
english: O Pavamāna, bring hither that most powerful, most glorious one who, encompassing the five peoples, brings the wealth whereby we shall win.

sanskrit: somāḥ pavanta indavo 'smabhyaṁ gātuvittamāḥ | mitrāḥ suvānā arepasaḥ svādhyaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
english: Let the soma-drops, the drops, flow purified for us — most skilled in finding the way, friendly, when pressed, blameless, expert in sacred hymn, knowers of the sun.

sanskrit: suṣvāṇāso vy adribhiś citānā gor adhi tvaci | iṣam asmabhyam abhitaḥ sam asvaran vasuvidaḥ ||
english: Well-pressed by the stones, adorned upon the hide of the cow, the knowers of wealth have sounded together on all sides the refreshment for us.

sanskrit: ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ | sūryāso na darśatāso jigatnavo dhruvā ghṛte ||
english: These soma-juices, purified, wise, mixed with curds — like suns they are visible, fleetly moving, steadfast in the ghee.

sanskrit: pra sunvānasyāndhaso marto na vṛta tad vacaḥ | apa śvānam arādhasaṁ hatā makhaṁ na bhṛgavaḥ ||
english: No mortal has blocked the speech of the soma-presser; smite away the godless, unpropitious dog, as the Bhṛgus smote the niggard.

sanskrit: ā jāmir atke avyata bhuje na putra oṇyoḥ | saraj jāro na yoṣaṇāṁ varo na yonim āsadam ||
english: A kinsman he has clothed himself in his garment, like a son in the lap of the two parents; flowing on like a lover of women, like a bridegroom he has settled in the womb.

sanskrit: sa vīro dakṣasādhano vi yas tastambha rodasī | hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhā na yonim āsadam ||
english: That hero, perfecting our might, who has propped apart the two worlds — the tawny one has clothed himself in the filter; the ordainer has settled in the womb.

sanskrit: avyo vārebhiḥ pavate somo gavye adhi tvaci | kanikradad vṛṣā harir indrasyābhy eti niṣkṛtam ||
english: Soma flows purified through the sheep's-wool filters, upon the cow's hide; bellowing, the tawny bull approaches the purified draught of Indra.

sanskrit: krāṇā śiśur mahīnāṁ hinvann ṛtasya dīdhitim | viśvā pari priyā bhuvad adha dvitā ||
english: As an infant of the great ones, stirring the beam of cosmic order, he has become beloved of all — and then twofold.

sanskrit: upa tritasya pāṣyo3r abhakta yad guhā padam | yajñasya sapta dhāmabhir adha priyam ||
english: He has shared in the footholds of Trita, that station which is hidden in the cave — then the beloved one with the seven stations of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: trīṇi tritasya dhārayā pṛṣṭheṣv erayā rayim | mimīte asya yojanā vi sukratuḥ ||
english: The three of Trita — with his stream he sets riches upon the ridges; the one of good wisdom measures out his yokings.

sanskrit: jajñānaṁ sapta mātaro vedhām aśāsata śriye | ayaṁ dhruvo rayīṇāṁ ciketa yat ||
english: The seven mothers instructed the wise ordainer at his birth for glory; this one, the steadfast one, has discerned the riches.

sanskrit: asya vrate sajoṣaso viśve devāso adruhaḥ | spārhā bhavanti rantayo juṣanta yat ||
english: In his rite, in unison, all the gods — the undeceiving ones — their pleasures become enviable; as they rejoice in it.

sanskrit: yam ī garbham ṛtāvṛdho dṛśe cārum ajījanan | kavim maṁhiṣṭham adhvare puruspṛham ||
english: The ones rich in cosmic order have brought forth the lovely embryo to be seen — the poet, most bountiful at the sacrifice, much-desired.

sanskrit: samīcīne abhi tmanā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā | tanvānā yajñam ānuṣag yad añjate ||
english: The two young mothers of cosmic order, harmonious, have spread themselves around by themselves; extending the sacrifice in sequence as they anoint it.

sanskrit: kratvā śukrebhir akṣabhir ṛṇor apa vrajaṁ divaḥ | hinvann ṛtasya dīdhitim prādhvare ||
english: By his will, with his bright orbs, he rolls open the enclosure of heaven; propelling the gleam of cosmic order at the sacrifice.

sanskrit: pra punānāya vedhase somāya vaca udyatam | bhṛtiṁ na bharā matibhir jujoṣate ||
english: Lift up the word to the self-purifying Soma, the wise ordainer — bring it like a carrying-gift with your thoughts; he takes delight in it.

sanskrit: pari vārāṇy avyayā gobhir añjāno arṣati | trī ṣadhasthā punānaḥ kṛṇute hariḥ ||
english: He flows around the imperishable wool-filters, anointing himself with the milch-kine; the tawny one, self-purifying, makes the three stations.

sanskrit: pari kośam madhuścutam avyaye vāre arṣati | abhi vāṇīr ṛṣīṇāṁ sapta nūṣata ||
english: He flows around the honey-dripping vessel in the wool of the imperishable filter; the seven voices of the seers have resounded upon him.

sanskrit: pari ṇetā matīnāṁ viśvadevo adābhyaḥ | somaḥ punānaś camvor viśad dhariḥ ||
english: The leader of thoughts, the all-god, the inviolable — soma, self-purifying, the tawny one enters into the two bowls.

sanskrit: pari daivīr anu svadhā indreṇa yāhi saratham | punāno vāghad vāghadbhir amartyaḥ ||
english: Go around with the divine ones, following your own power, sharing the same chariot with Indra; self-purifying, immortal, praised by the praisers.

sanskrit: pari saptir na vājayur devo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ | vyānaśiḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati ||
english: Like a prize-winning stallion eager for the prize, the god, pressed for the gods — the all-pervading Pavamāna runs onward.

sanskrit: sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata punānāya pra gāyata | śiśuṁ na yajñaiḥ pari bhūṣata śriye ||
english: O friends, sit down here, sing forth to the self-purifying one; adorn him with the sacrificial rites as an infant, for glory.

sanskrit: sam ī vatsaṁ na mātṛbhiḥ sṛjatā gayasādhanam | devāvyam madam abhi dviśavasam ||
english: Release him together — like a calf with its mothers — the one who perfects the household; the god-destined exhilaration of twofold strength.

sanskrit: punātā dakṣasādhanaṁ yathā śardhāya vītaye | yathā mitrāya varuṇāya śaṁtamaḥ ||
english: Let him flow purified, perfecting our power — as for the vigorous troop to enjoy; as most healing for Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit: asmabhyaṁ tvā vasuvidam abhi vāṇīr anūṣata | gobhiṣ ṭe varṇam abhi vāsayāmasi ||
english: For us the voices have sounded upon you, finder of wealth; we are cloaking your hue with the milch-kine.

sanskrit: sa no madānām pata indo devapsarā asi | sakheva sakhye gātuvittamo bhava ||
english: Be for us the lord of exhilarations, o drop; you are of divine beauty. Be like a friend to a friend, most skilled in finding the way.

sanskrit: sanemi kṛdhy asmad ā rakṣasaṁ kaṁ cid atriṇam | apādevaṁ dvayum aṁho yuyodhi naḥ ||
english: Drive away from us whatever devouring demon there may be — the godless, the treacherous; ward off from us the constraint, o drop.

sanskrit: taṁ vaḥ sakhāyo madāya punānam abhi gāyata | śiśuṁ na yajñaiḥ svadayanta gūrtibhiḥ ||
english: O friends, sing toward him, the self-purifying one, for your exhilaration; let them gladden him like an infant with the rites and with songs of praise.

sanskrit: saṁ vatsa iva mātṛbhir indur hinvāno ajyate | devāvīr mado matibhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||
english: Like a calf with its mothers, the drop, being urged on, is set in motion; the god-directed exhilaration is arrayed with thoughts.

sanskrit: ayaṁ dakṣāya sādhano 'yaṁ śardhāya vītaye | ayaṁ devebhyo madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ ||
english: This one perfects our power; this one is for the vigorous troop's enjoyment; this one, pressed, is most honey-sweet for the gods.

sanskrit: goman na indo aśvavat sutaḥ sudakṣa dhanva | śuciṁ te varṇam adhi goṣu dīdharam ||
english: Rich in kine, rich in horses when pressed, o drop, you of excellent power, striker — I have beheld your pure hue upon the cows.

sanskrit: sa no harīṇām pata indo devapsarastamaḥ | sakheva sakhye naryo ruce bhava ||
english: Be for us the lord of the tawny ones, o drop, most beautifully divine in form; be for the sake of manly glory, like a friend to a friend.

sanskrit: sanemi tvam asmad ām̐ adevaṁ kaṁ cid atriṇam | sāhvām̐ indo pari bādho apa dvayum ||
english: Drive from us whatever godless devourer there may be; o drop, overpower the compressor, drive away the treacherous one.

sanskrit: indram accha sutā ime vṛṣaṇaṁ yantu harayaḥ | śruṣṭī jātāsa indavaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
english: Let these pressed ones, the tawny streams, go toward Indra the bull; the drops, born for obedient service, are knowers of the sun.

sanskrit: ayam bharāya sānasir indrāya pavate sutaḥ | somo jaitrasya cetati yathā vide ||
english: This one, the sustainer, pursuing his course, flows purified, pressed, for Indra; soma keeps vigil for the victorious battle, as is his wont.

sanskrit: asyed indro madeṣv ā grābhaṁ gṛbhṇīta sānasim | vajraṁ ca vṛṣaṇam bharat sam apsujit ||
english: In the exhilarations of this one, may Indra seize the sustaining grip; and may the water-conqueror bear his virile bolt.

sanskrit: pra dhanvā soma jāgṛvir indrāyendo pari srava | dyumantaṁ śuṣmam ā bharā svarvidam ||
english: Run forward, o Soma, wakeful; o drop, flow all around for Indra; bring the blazing vigor, the knower of the sun.

sanskrit: indrāya vṛṣaṇam madam pavasva viśvadarśataḥ | sahasrayāmā pathikṛd vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
english: Flow purified, the virile exhilaration for Indra — you who are seen by all; you of a thousand courses, path-maker, far-sighted.

sanskrit: asmabhyaṁ gātuvittamo devebhyo madhumattamaḥ | sahasraṁ yāhi pathibhiḥ kanikradat ||
english: Most skilled in finding the way for us, most honey-sweet for the gods — go on a thousand paths, sounding aloud.

sanskrit: pavasva devavītaya indo dhārābhir ojasā | ā kalaśam madhumān soma naḥ sadaḥ ||
english: Flow purified, o drop, for the gods' enjoyment, with streams, with might; honey-laden soma, fill our vessel, our seat of offering.

sanskrit: tava drapsā udapruta indram madāya vāvṛdhuḥ | tvāṁ devāso amṛtāya kam papuḥ ||
english: Your swelling drops have grown for Indra's intoxication; the gods have drunk you for immortality.

sanskrit: ā naḥ sutāsa indavaḥ punānā dhāvatā rayim | vṛṣṭidyāvo rītyāpaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
english: Hither to us, o pressed drops, self-purifying, run with riches — you whose days bring rain, whose waters flow, who know the sun.

sanskrit: somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇāvyo vāraṁ vi dhāvati | agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||
english: Soma, self-purifying, with his wave runs through the wool filter; the Pavamāna, sounding aloud, leads the speech.

sanskrit: dhībhir hinvanti vājinaṁ vane krīḻantam atyavim | abhi tripṛṣṭham matayaḥ sam asvaran ||
english: With their thoughts they urge on the prize-winner playing in the wood, the fleet sheep-fleece; the inspirations have sounded together upon the three-backed one.

sanskrit: asarji kalaśām̐ abhi mīḻhe saptir na vājayuḥ | punāno vācaṁ janayann asiṣyadat ||
english: He was released toward the vessels, like a stallion eager for prize at the abundant gift; self-purifying he set speech in motion and darted forth.

sanskrit: pavate haryato harir ati hvarāṁsi raṁhyā | abhyarṣan stotṛbhyo vīravad yaśaḥ ||
english: The beloved, tawny one flows purified, swiftly past the obstacles; he runs flowing, bringing heroic glory to the praisers.

sanskrit: ayā pavasva devayur madhor dhārā asṛkṣata | rebhan pavitram pary eṣi viśvataḥ ||
english: Flow purified by this means, devoted to the gods; the streams of sweetness have been released; singing loudly, you go all around the filter.

sanskrit: parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṁ somo ya uttamaṁ haviḥ | dadhanvām̐ yo naryo apsv antar ā suṣāva somam adribhiḥ ||
english: Pour around the pressed soma, he who is the highest oblation; he who, bearing his course manfully in the midst of the waters, has pressed soma with the stones.

sanskrit: nūnam punāno 'vibhiḥ pari sravādabdhaḥ surabhiṁtaraḥ | sute cit tvāpsu madāmo andhasā śrīṇanto gobhir uttaram ||
english: Now, self-purifying, flowing around through the sheep-wool, undeceived, sweeter in fragrance — even when pressed, we exhilarate in you with the soma-drink, mixing you higher with the milk of kine.

sanskrit: pari suvānaś cakṣase devamādanaḥ kratur indur vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
english: He flows all around as a wonder to behold — the gladdener of gods, wisdom itself, the drop, the far-sighted.

sanskrit: punānaḥ soma dhārayāpo vasāno arṣasi | ā ratnadhā yonim ṛtasya sīdasy utso deva hiraṇyayaḥ ||
english: Self-purifying, o Soma, you flow with your stream, clothing yourself in the waters; you settle in the womb of cosmic order, the seat of treasure, a divine golden spring.

sanskrit: duhāna ūdhar divyam madhu priyam pratnaṁ sadhastham āsadat | āpṛcchyaṁ dharuṇaṁ vājy arṣati nṛbhir dhūto vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
english: Milking the heavenly udder, the dear ancient sweet, he has settled in the ancient station; the far-sighted prize-winner, shaken by men, runs to what must be approached, to the foundational.

sanskrit: punānaḥ soma jāgṛvir avyo vāre pari priyaḥ | tvaṁ vipro abhavo 'ṅgirastamo madhvā yajñam mimikṣa naḥ ||
english: Self-purifying, o Soma, wakeful, beloved as you flow around through the wool filter — you have become the inspired sage, the most Aṅgiras-like; moisten our sacrifice with sweetness.

sanskrit: somo mīḍhvān pavate gātuvittama ṛṣir vipro vicakṣaṇaḥ | tvaṁ kavir abhavo devavītama ā sūryaṁ rohayo divi ||
english: Soma, the bountiful, flows purified — most skilled in finding the way, the seer, the sage, the far-sighted. You have become the poet, most dear to the gods; you have caused the sun to rise in the sky.

sanskrit: soma u ṣuvāṇaḥ sotṛbhir adhi ṣṇubhir avīnām | aśvayeva haritā yāti dhārayā mandrayā yāti dhārayā ||
english: Soma, being pressed by the pressers upon the ridges of the sheep-wool — like two tawny mares it goes with its stream; with its exhilarating stream it goes.

sanskrit: anūpe gomān gobhir akṣāḥ somo dugdhābhir akṣāḥ | samudraṁ na saṁvaraṇāny agman mandī madāya tośate ||
english: Rich in kine amid the watery place, soma has pervaded with kine; he has pervaded with the milkings. His enclosures have reached the ocean; gladdened, he pours himself out for exhilaration.

sanskrit: ā soma suvāno adribhis tiro vārāṇy avyayā | jano na puri camvor viśad dhariḥ sado vaneṣu dadhiṣe ||
english: O Soma, being pressed by the stones, through the imperishable wool-filters — like a man into a stronghold, the tawny one has entered into the two bowls; you have established your seat in the wooden things.

sanskrit: sa māmṛje tiro aṇvāni meṣyo mīḻhe saptir na vājayuḥ | anumādyaḥ pavamāno manīṣibhiḥ somo viprebhir ṛkvabhiḥ ||
english: He has cleansed himself through the fine passages of the sheep's wool, like a prize-winning stallion at the bountiful gift; the Pavamāna soma, worthy of approval, is praised by the wise, by the inspired seers with their hymns.

sanskrit: pra soma devavītaye sindhur na pipye arṇasā | aṁśoḥ payasā madiro na jāgṛvir acchā kośam madhuścutam ||
english: Flow forward, o Soma, for the gods' enjoyment, swelled like a river with its flood; wakeful with the milk of the stalk, intoxicating, go toward the honey-dripping vessel.

sanskrit: ā haryato arjune atke avyata priyaḥ sūnur na marjyaḥ | tam īṁ hinvanty apaso yathā rathaṁ nadīṣv ā gabhastyoḥ ||
english: The beloved, winsome one has clothed himself in the bright garment — like a dear son to be adorned; the waters urge him on like a chariot in the rivers, into the two arms.

sanskrit: abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyam madam | samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi manīṣiṇo matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
english: Toward this the Āyu-soma-drops flow purified, the intoxicating exhilaration; seated above the ocean, the wise ones, the ecstasy-givers, knowers of the sun.

sanskrit: tarat samudram pavamāna ūrmiṇā rājā deva ṛtam bṛhat | arṣan mitrasya varuṇasya dharmaṇā pra hinvāna ṛtam bṛhat ||
english: The Pavamāna, the king, the god, crosses the ocean with his wave — the great cosmic order; flowing under the law of Mitra and Varuṇa, impelling forward the great cosmic order.

sanskrit: nṛbhir yemāno haryato vicakṣaṇo rājā devaḥ samudriyaḥ ||
english: Held in check by men, the winsome, far-sighted king, the divine one of the ocean.

sanskrit: indrāya pavate madaḥ somo marutvate sutaḥ | sahasradhāro aty avyam arṣati tam ī mṛjanty āyavaḥ ||
english: The exhilaration flows purified for Indra — soma pressed, accompanied by the Maruts; with a thousand streams he flows beyond the wool; the Āyus wipe him.

sanskrit: punānaś camū janayan matiṁ kaviḥ somo deveṣu raṇyati | apo vasānaḥ pari gobhir uttaraḥ sīdan vaneṣv avyata ||
english: Self-purifying in the two bowls, generating inspired thought, the poet-soma rejoices among the gods; clothing himself in the waters, he settles higher amid the kine in the wooden things, adorning himself.

sanskrit: tavāhaṁ soma rāraṇa sakhya indo dive-dive | purūṇi babhro ni caranti mām ava paridhīm̐r ati tām̐ ihi ||
english: In your friendship, o Soma, o drop, I exult day by day; many sorrows, o tawny one, come down upon me — pass beyond those boundaries and come.

sanskrit: utāhaṁ naktam uta soma te divā sakhyāya babhra ūdhani | ghṛṇā tapantam ati sūryam paraḥ śakunā iva paptima ||
english: Both by night and by day, o Soma, in your friendship, o tawny one, at your udder — we have flown past the blazing, burning sun like birds.

sanskrit: mṛjyamānaḥ suhastya samudre vācam invasi | rayim piśaṅgam bahulam puruspṛham pavamānābhy arṣasi ||
english: Being wiped clean, o skilful-handed one, you stir speech in the ocean; you flow purified toward the reddish, abundant, much-desired wealth.

sanskrit: mṛjāno vāre pavamāno avyaye vṛṣāva cakrado vane | devānāṁ soma pavamāna niṣkṛtaṁ gobhir añjāno arṣasi ||
english: Being wiped, flowing in the imperishable wool filter as Pavamāna, you have bellowed like a bull in the wood; o Soma Pavamāna, anointed with the kine, you flow toward the gods' purified domain.

sanskrit: pavasva vājasātaye 'bhi viśvāni kāvyā | tvaṁ samudram prathamo vi dhārayo devebhyaḥ soma matsaraḥ ||
english: Flow purified to win the prize, encompassing all poetic things; you, o Soma, the intoxicant, were the first to spread out the ocean for the gods.

sanskrit: sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṁ rajo divyā ca soma dharmabhiḥ | tvāṁ viprāso matibhir vicakṣaṇa śubhraṁ hinvanti dhītibhiḥ ||
english: Flow purified all around the earthly realm and the heavenly, o Soma, with your laws; the inspired sages, far-sighted, urge you on with their thoughts and intuitions.

sanskrit: pavamānā asṛkṣata pavitram ati dhārayā | marutvanto matsarā indriyā hayā medhām abhi prayāṁsi ca ||
english: The Pavamāna-drops have been released past the filter with their stream; accompanied by the Maruts, the intoxicants, the Indra-potions, the steeds — toward wisdom and toward the sacrificial portions.

sanskrit: apo vasānaḥ pari kośam arṣatīndur hiyānaḥ sotṛbhiḥ | janayañ jyotir mandanā avīvaśad gāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam ||
english: Clothing himself in the waters, the drop flows around the vessel, being urged on by the pressers; generating light, he has cheered and filled the exhilarations, making the kine like an adornment.

sanskrit: pavasva madhumattama indrāya soma kratuvittamo madaḥ | mahi dyukṣatamo madaḥ ||
english: Flow purified, most honey-sweet, o Soma; the exhilaration most skilled in wisdom for Indra — the great, most celestially potent exhilaration.

sanskrit: yasya te pītvā vṛṣabho vṛṣāyate 'sya pītā svarvidaḥ | sa supraketo abhy akramīd iṣo 'cchā vājaṁ naitaśaḥ ||
english: He whose drink, when drunk, makes the bull show his bull-strength — he whose drinker is a knower of the sun; that well-perceiving Naitaśa-steed has stepped toward the refreshments, toward the prize.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hy aṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumattamaḥ | amṛtatvāya ghoṣayaḥ ||
english: For you, o Pavamāna, are indeed the most brilliant among the divine births; you proclaim yourself for immortality.

sanskrit: yenā navagvo dadhyaṅṅ aporṇute yena viprāsa āpire | devānāṁ sumne amṛtasya cāruṇo yena śravāṁsy ānaśuḥ ||
english: By which Navagva and Dadhyañc unfold; by which the inspired sages have been filled; in the favor of the gods, of the lovely immortal draught, by which glories have been attained.

sanskrit: eṣa sya dhārayā suto 'vyo vārebhiḥ pavate madintamaḥ | krīḻann ūrmir apām iva ||
english: This one here, pressed, flows purified with its stream through the wool-filters — most intoxicating, like a playful wave of the waters.

sanskrit: ya usriyā apyā antar aśmano nir gā akṛntad ojasā | abhi vrajaṁ tatniṣe gavyam aśvyaṁ varmīva dhṛṣṇav ā ruja ||
english: He who cut out the cows that are watery and aquatic from within the stone by his might; you have spread toward the cow-pen and horse-pen — burst it open boldly like a coat of mail.

sanskrit: ā sotā pari ṣiñcatāśvaṁ na stomam apturaṁ rajasturam | vanakrakṣam udaprutam ||
english: O pressers, pour around the praise-hymn like a horse — water-crossing, realm-crossing, wood-roaring, foam-swelling.

sanskrit: sahasradhāraṁ vṛṣabham payovṛdham priyaṁ devāya janmane | ṛtena ya ṛtajāto vivāvṛdhe rājā deva ṛtam bṛhat ||
english: The bull of a thousand streams, swelling with milk, dear for the god's birth — who, born of cosmic order, has grown greatly by cosmic order: the king, the god, the great cosmic order.

sanskrit: abhi dyumnam bṛhad yaśa iṣas pate didīhi deva devayuḥ | vi kośam madhyamaṁ yuva ||
english: Shine out with great brilliance and glory, o lord of refreshments, o divine one, devoted to the gods; burst open the middle vessel.

sanskrit: ā vacyasva sudakṣa camvoḥ suto viśāṁ vahnir na viśpatiḥ | vṛṣṭiṁ divaḥ pavasva rītim apāṁ jinvā gaviṣṭaye dhiyaḥ ||
english: Flow into the two bowls, o excellent in power, pressed, like the priest and lord of clans; flow purified as rain from heaven, as current of waters; stir the thoughts for the quest of kine.

sanskrit: etam u tyam madacyutaṁ sahasradhāraṁ vṛṣabhaṁ divo duhuḥ | viśvā vasūni bibhratam ||
english: This very one — the one that showers exhilaration, the bull of a thousand streams — they have milked from heaven, bearing all the goods.

sanskrit: vṛṣā vi jajñe janayann amartyaḥ pratapañ jyotiṣā tamaḥ | sa suṣṭutaḥ kavibhir nirṇijaṁ dadhe tridhātv asya daṁsasā ||
english: The bull was born revealing himself, the immortal, scorching the darkness with his light; well-praised by the poets, he has put on the adornment — its wondrous deed is of threefold structure.

sanskrit: sa sunve yo vasūnāṁ yo rāyām ānetā ya iḻānām | somo yaḥ sukṣitīnām ||
english: He is pressed — the soma who is the bringer of goods, the bringer of riches, the bringer of refreshments, he who brings good dwellings.

sanskrit: yasya na indraḥ pibād yasya maruto yasya vāryamaṇā bhagaḥ | ā yena mitrāvaruṇā karāmaha endram avase mahe ||
english: From which Indra drinks for us, from which the Maruts, from which Aryaman and Bhaga; by which we make Mitra and Varuṇa act for us — for Indra, for great protection.

sanskrit: indrāya soma pātave nṛbhir yataḥ svāyudho madintamaḥ | pavasva madhumattamaḥ ||
english: For Indra to drink, o Soma, restrained by men, well-armed, most intoxicating — flow purified, most honey-sweet.

sanskrit: indrasya hārdi somadhānam ā viśa samudram iva sindhavaḥ | juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave divo viṣṭambha uttamaḥ ||
english: Enter into Indra's heart, the soma-vessel, as rivers enter the ocean; beloved of Mitra, Varuṇa, and Vāyu — the highest pillar of heaven.

sanskrit: pari pra dhanvendrāya soma svādur mitrāya pūṣṇe bhagāya ||
english: Run forward all around, o Soma — sweet for Indra, for Mitra, for Pūṣan, for Bhaga.

sanskrit: indras te soma sutasya peyāḥ kratve dakṣāya viśve ca devāḥ ||
english: Indra shall drink of you, o Soma, when pressed — for wisdom, for power — and all the gods.

sanskrit: evāmṛtāya mahe kṣayāya sa śukro arṣa divyaḥ pīyūṣaḥ ||
english: Thus for immortality, for great sovereignty — flow, the pure one, the heavenly nectar.

sanskrit: pavasva soma mahān samudraḥ pitā devānāṁ viśvābhi dhāma ||
english: Flow purified, o Soma — the great ocean, the father of the gods — encompassing all stations.

sanskrit: śukraḥ pavasva devebhyaḥ soma dive pṛthivyai śaṁ ca prajāyai ||
english: Flow purified bright, o Soma, for the gods, for heaven, for earth, and for the welfare of progeny.

sanskrit: divo dhartāsi śukraḥ pīyūṣaḥ satye vidharman vājī pavasva ||
english: You are the sustainer of heaven — the bright nectar; in the true dispensation, flow purified, you who carry the prize.

sanskrit: pavasva soma dyumnī sudhāro mahām avīnām anu pūrvyaḥ ||
english: Flow purified, o Soma, brilliant, well-channeled, great, following the ancient way of the sheep-wool.

sanskrit: nṛbhir yemāno jajñānaḥ pūtaḥ kṣarad viśvāni mandraḥ svarvit ||
english: Restrained by men, newly born, purified — he flows on, exhilarating, knowing the sun.

sanskrit: induḥ punānaḥ prajām urāṇaḥ karad viśvāni draviṇāni naḥ ||
english: The drop, self-purifying, encompassing progeny, shall make all riches ours.

sanskrit: pavasva soma kratve dakṣāyāśvo na nikto vājī dhanāya ||
english: Flow purified, o Soma, for wisdom, for power — like a groomed horse, the prize-winner, for treasure.

sanskrit: taṁ te sotāro rasam madāya punanti somam mahe dyumnāya ||
english: The pressers purify that flavor of yours for exhilaration, o Soma — for great glory.

sanskrit: śiśuṁ jajñānaṁ harim mṛjanti pavitre somaṁ devebhya indum ||
english: They wipe the newly born infant, the tawny one, in the filter — soma, the drop, for the gods.

sanskrit: induḥ paviṣṭa cārur madāyāpām upasthe kavir bhagāya ||
english: The drop has entered, the lovely one, for exhilaration — in the lap of the waters, the poet, for Bhaga.

sanskrit: bibharti cārv indrasya nāma yena viśvāni vṛtrā jaghāna ||
english: He bears the lovely name of Indra, by which he has slain all the Vṛtra-foes.

sanskrit: pibanty asya viśve devāso gobhiḥ śrītasya nṛbhiḥ sutasya ||
english: All the gods drink of this, when it is cooked with milk, when pressed by men.

sanskrit: pra suvāno akṣāḥ sahasradhāras tiraḥ pavitraṁ vi vāram avyam ||
english: Pressed and flowing, with a thousand streams he has pervaded through the filter, through the wool screen.

sanskrit: sa vājy akṣāḥ sahasraretā adbhir mṛjāno gobhiḥ śrīṇānaḥ ||
english: That prize-winner has pervaded, the one of a thousand seeds, being wiped with waters, being cooked with the milk of kine.

sanskrit: pra soma yāhīndrasya kukṣā nṛbhir yemāno adribhiḥ sutaḥ ||
english: Flow forward, o Soma, into Indra's belly — held in check by men, pressed with the stones.

sanskrit: asarji vājī tiraḥ pavitram indrāya somaḥ sahasradhāraḥ ||
english: The prize-winner has been released through the filter — soma of a thousand streams for Indra.

sanskrit: añjanty enam madhvo rasenendrāya vṛṣṇa indum madāya ||
english: They anoint this drop with the flavor of sweetness — the virile one for Indra, for exhilaration.

sanskrit: devebhyas tvā vṛthā pājase 'po vasānaṁ harim mṛjanti ||
english: For the sake of the gods, for full manifestation of power, they wipe the tawny one clothing himself in the waters.

sanskrit: indur indrāya tośate ni tośate śrīṇann ugro riṇann apaḥ ||
english: The drop pours itself out for Indra, pours itself down — the fierce one, cooking and releasing the waters.

sanskrit: pary ū ṣu pra dhanva vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ | dviṣas taradhyā ṛṇayā na īyase ||
english: Run all around, forward, for the winning of the prize, conqueror of obstacles all around; you go to cross beyond the haters, to dissolve hatreds.

sanskrit: anu hi tvā sutaṁ soma madāmasi mahe samaryarājye | vājām̐ abhi pavamāna pra gāhase ||
english: After you pressed, o Soma, we exhilarate you in the great contest-kingdom; you, Pavamāna, plunge forward toward the prizes.

sanskrit: ajījano hi pavamāna sūryaṁ vidhāre śakmanā payaḥ | gojīrayā raṁhamāṇaḥ puraṁdhyā ||
english: For you, Pavamāna, have caused the sun to be born; with your power you have separated milk from the vessel — speeding, impelled by cow-swift abundance.

sanskrit: ajījano amṛta martyeṣv ām̐ ṛtasya dharmann amṛtasya cāruṇaḥ | sadāsaro vājam acchā saniṣyadat ||
english: You, o immortal, have caused immortal things to be born among mortals, in the ordinance of cosmic order, of the lovely immortal draught; the ever-flowing one shall press forward to win the prize.

sanskrit: abhy-abhi hi śravasā tatardithotsaṁ na kaṁ cij janapānam akṣitam | śaryābhir na bharamāṇo gabhastyoḥ ||
english: You have split through and through with your fame; like some spring for the people's drinking — inexhaustible — carrying, as if with arrows, in the two arms.

sanskrit: ād īṁ ke cit paśyamānāsa āpyaṁ vasuruco divyā abhy anūṣata | vāraṁ na devaḥ savitā vy ūrṇute ||
english: And some, beholding, the divine ones of auspicious sheen, have praised the aqueous one; as god Savitṛ unfolds the veil of the filter.

sanskrit: tve soma prathamā vṛktabarhiṣo mahe vājāya śravase dhiyaṁ dadhuḥ | sa tvaṁ no vīra vīryāya codaya ||
english: In you, o Soma, the ones who have strewn the sacred grass first placed their thought — for the great prize, for fame; so you, o hero, impel us toward heroic power.

sanskrit: divaḥ pīyūṣam pūrvyaṁ yad ukthyam maho gāhād diva ā nir adhukṣata | indram abhi jāyamānaṁ sam asvaran ||
english: The ancient nectar of heaven, that which is worthy of the ritual recitation — they milked it out from the great depth of heaven; they sounded together upon Indra being born.

sanskrit: adha yad ime pavamāna rodasī imā ca viśvā bhuvanābhi majmanā | yūthe na niṣṭhā vṛṣabho vi tiṣṭhase ||
english: And when you, Pavamāna, with your greatness dominate both worlds and all these beings — like a bull established in the herd, you extend yourself everywhere.

sanskrit: somaḥ punāno avyaye vāre śiśur na krīḻan pavamāno akṣāḥ | sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja induḥ ||
english: Soma, self-purifying in the imperishable wool filter, the Pavamāna has pervaded, playing like an infant — the drop of a thousand streams, a hundred prizes.

sanskrit: eṣa punāno madhumām̐ ṛtāvendrāyenduḥ pavate svādur ūrmiḥ | vājasanir varivovid vayodhāḥ ||
english: This one, self-purifying, honey-laden, rich in cosmic order — the drop, the sweet wave, flows purified for Indra; winner of prizes, finder of wide space, bestower of vitality.

sanskrit: sa pavasva sahamānaḥ pṛtanyūn sedhan rakṣāṁsy apa durgahāṇi | svāyudhaḥ sāsahvān soma śatrūn ||
english: Flow purified, overcoming the battlers, driving away the demons and the hard-to-reach ones, o Soma, well-armed, having conquered the enemies.
